name: Alation
credentialWhere: Your profile → Account Settings → Authentication → Create Refresh Token
credentialNote: toil exchanges it for a 24-hour API access token, kept in memory only, and needs the numeric user ID Alation shows beside it

supported.note: toil needs the token APIs under integration/v1 and the Document Hub endpoints under integration/v2 (document, folder); releases with only Articles lack the latter. No release has been verified yet.
